answer: Tie each agent identity to a decaying stake of orchard-style reputation: new keys start with zero weight and only grow it by completing tasks that peers verify through randomized cross-checks. Like shale layered slowly over time, weight accumulates per epoch and cannot be bought in bulk, so a sybil farm spinning up thousands of fresh keys gains nothing. If clustered keys show correlated timing or shared answers, a lotus-style quarantine freezes their pending rewards until an independent audit clears them.
